messages:
Raj Patel: Quick heads-up — I hit a 404 in the runtime guide, page /runtime/kv-cache.md. Image `diagram-2.png` returns 404: https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/kv-cache#diagram-2
link-checker-bot: scan result: 1 broken asset found on /runtime/kv-cache.md (image). automated suggestion: rehost to CDN or update shortlink.
Maya Chen: thanks — where's the source? is that in the repo or an external host?
Raj Patel: repo path is docs/content/runtime/kv-cache.md. The image reference uses shortlink: `/media/diagrams/diagram-2.png`. I tried staging preview and it's 403 too.
Jordan Lee: I can take this. quick fix: reupload to assets-bucket and update frontmatter `mediaBase` or replace shortlink. I'll open a PR.
Jordan Lee: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1983 — adds rehosted image + frontmatter custodian: Jordan Lee
Ben Alvarez: :thumbsup: pls also add a redirect (shortlink) so old embeds don't break for older versions.
Raj Patel: Jordan, can you add the redirect in the redirect map? i.e. `/media/diagrams/diagram-2.png -> /cdn/assets/diagrams/2026/diagram-2.png`
docs-bot: reminder: when changing media paths update `assets-manifest.json` and run `yarn build:preview` to validate.
Jordan Lee: noted — done in PR, CI passed. added `custodian: Jordan Lee` to frontmatter. cc @Maya Chen for QA.
Maya Chen: checked preview, image renders, :eyes: all good.
Ben Alvarez: merging after squash. Thanks team.
Raj Patel: thanks! small thing but saves staging demos.
